scalar_and_matrix_domain.invariance_lemma: For any invertible complex S, tr((S^-1 X S)^2)=tr(S^-1 X^2 S)=tr(X^2). Therefore unequal trace-square values obstruct complex similarity. This is elementary exact finite matrix algebra, not a new source axiom.
